rules.why: The item is a native <details>: the browser announces and toggles the state.
The header is the native <summary>, pure, with no manual ARIA and never disabled.
The title is the announced name.
A heading inside <summary> leaves the headings list in some screen readers.
rules.on: .al-accordion__header h1, .al-accordion__header h2, .al-accordion__header h3, .al-accordion__header h4, .al-accordion__header h5, .al-accordion__header h6

rules.why: The whole header is already the button.
Exactly one content block per item.
An Accordion never goes inside another.
The icon and the chevron are paint; the title speaks.

manual.why: The <summary> is the first child of the <details>; the content is a direct child that comes after it.
Nothing focusable inside the <summary> (tabindex, actionable roles): the whole header is already the button.
An item with no content leaves the stack; it is never disabled.
